## Introduction

Aspose.3D FOSS for Python is a zero-dependency, MIT-licensed library for loading and
converting 3D models.

## Quick Start

Install the library:

```bash
pip install aspose-3d-foss
```

Load a model:

```python
from aspose.threed import Scene
scene = Scene.from_file("model.obj")
```

## Supported Formats

The library supports OBJ, STL, glTF, COLLADA, and 3MF formats.
